High Point (27-5)Mar 15, 2026 - 6:53p ET Full 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Bracket Here is a look at the complete 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament bracket.Duke received the top overall seed on Sunday, followed by Arizona, Michigan and Florida.The top line was the most predictable thing to come out of Selection Sunday, with Michigan’s placement at overall No. 3, not 2, possibly a result of the Wolverines’ loss to Purdue in the Big Ten Tournament championship game, moments before the brackets were revealed.Miami (Ohio) made the field as a No. 11 seed, but just barely. The RedHawks, with a 31-1 record but the 339th-ranked strength of schedule, were one of the last teams in the field. They face a First Four game Wednesday against SMU.The tournament starts Tuesday with other play-in games, including one pitting bubble teams and No. 11 seeds Texas and North Carolina State. The national champion will be crowned at the Final Four in Indianapolis on April 6.Mar 15, 2026 - 6:37p ET NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Bracket Reveal: South Region South Region1. Idaho (21-14)FOX Sports' Michael Cohen South Region Analysis:Florida, the defending national champion, earned the final No. 1 seed in this year's NCAA Tournament thanks to a remarkable second half of the season in which the Gators won 17 of 18 games from early January through mid-March. And who might be waiting for Florida in the Sweet 16? The same Vanderbilt team, now seeded fifth, that knocked Florida out of the SEC Tournament on Saturday. That's some fascinating bracketology from the selection committee. This quadrant is peppered with Big Ten flair from top to bottom: 9-seed Iowa, 4-seed Nebraska and 3-seed Illinois. Not to mention 14-seed Penn led by former Iowa head coach Fran McCaffery, now in his first season at his alma mater. But second-seeded Houston might be the team to watch as this tournament progresses. The Cougars rank among the top 15 nationally in both offensive and defensive efficiency, and now they have a bonafide lottery pick leading the way in freshman sensation Kingston Flemings (16.4 points per game). Is this finally the year when head coach Kelvin Sampson gets it done?Mar 15, 2026 - 6:29p ET NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Bracket Reveal: Midwest Region Midwest Region1. Michigan (31-3)16. Wright State (23-11)7. Kentucky (21-13)10. Santa Clara (26-8)2. Iowa State (27-7)15. Tennessee State (23-9)FOX Sports' Michael Cohen Midwest Region Analysis:Assured of a 1-seed for what feels like weeks, Michigan sits atop this region looking to bounce back from a surprising loss to Purdue in the Big Ten Tournament championship game. Exciting second-weekend matchups between the Wolverines and either fifth-seeded Texas Tech (12th nationally in offensive efficiency) or fourth-seeded Alabama (third nationally in offensive efficiency) could be must-watch television given the firepower all across the floor. The high-octane offense spreads from top to bottom in this quadrant, with second-seeded Iowa State (21st in offensive efficiency) and third-seeded Virginia (27th in offensive efficiency) presenting legitimate Final Four threats in their own right. But for this region, all eyes will be on 11-seed Miami (Ohio) early in the week for the First Four in Dayton. The RedHawks began their season with 31 consecutive wins before falling in the MAC Tournament. Now they'll have to slug it out with fellow 11-seed SMU in the play-in games to truly earn a spot in the field.Mar 15, 2026 - 6:18p ET NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Bracket Reveal: West Region West Region1. Queens (21-13)FOX Sports' Michael Cohen West Region Analysis:A stumble by Michigan in the Big Ten Tournament title game on Sunday, coupled with some injury concerns to No. 1 overall seed Duke, means that Arizona — the top seed in this region — enters the NCAA Tournament healthier and playing better than anyone else in the country. The Wildcats emerged from the slugfest Big 12 Tournament unscathed, which means they've won nine in a row entering the Big Dance. A fascinating potential matchup with fifth-seeded Arkansas looms for the second weekend after the Razorbacks raced through the SEC Tournament on the shoulders of superstar point guard Darius Acuff Jr. (22.7 points per game).This region has plenty of NBA Draft intrigue with Acuff at Arkansas, potential top overall pick AJ Dybantsa (25.3 points per game) at BYU and two likely lottery picks from Arizona in Brayden Burries (15.9 points per game) and Koa Peat (13.6 points per game). Red-hot Purdue, which won the Big Ten Tournament to earn a 2-seed, rounds out the bottom of the region.Mar 15, 2026 - 6:10p ET NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Bracket Reveal: East Region East Region1. Michigan State (25-7)14. North Dakota State (27-7)7. UCLA (23-11)10. UCF (21-11)2. UConn (29-5)15. Furman (22-12)FOX Sports' Michael Cohen East Region Analysis:This region is all about Duke. The Blue Devils are deserving of the No. 1 overall seed after storming through the ACC to earn both the regular season and tournament titles, with the latter coming sans two injured starters. One of the biggest road blocks standing between Duke and a potential run to the Final Four might be No. 5 seed St. John's, winners of both championships in the Big East following a demolition of UConn on Saturday night. Head coach Rick Pitino's team is playing much better than its seed, having lost just once since Jan. 3. And speaking of UConn, the Huskies secured the No. 2 seed in the East Region. They were playing as well as anyone in the country for much of the season but have limped down the stretch, dropping four games in the last five weeks. No. 3 Michigan State and No. 4 Kansas round out the firepower in this quadrant.Mar 15, 2026 - 5:55p ET Mike DeCourcy's Latest NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Projections In his latest bracket projections, FOX Sports bracket forecaster Mike DeCourcy has Duke, Florida, Michigan and Arizona as No. 1 seeds. Michigan, Duke and Arizona have separated themselves from the pack over the course of the season and appear firmly positioned to remain on the top line, while Florida is projected to hold onto the final No. 1 seed despite an unexpected loss to Vanderbilt in the SEC Tournament semifinal round.Check out the complete projections here.
